title: Wilbert Smith document naming von Neumann, Oppenheimer and Vannevar Bush on Roswell reverse-engineering team

tellings.quote: So he found that document, right? like saying or alleging that vonoman and per Oppenheimer I think it was >> and Vanavar Bush >> and Vanar Bush right were on the reverse engineering team for Roswell.

plain: A document linked to Wilbert B. Smith, a figure from Canada, is said to claim that the mathematician John von Neumann, Oppenheimer and the engineer Vannevar Bush were on a team doing reverse engineering (taking a device apart to learn how it works) on material from Roswell, the 1947 New Mexico incident where some say a craft crashed. An unnamed researcher tells Michels about it second-hand, saying someone "found that document" that was "saying or alleging" this. If true, it would put some of the country's leading wartime scientists at the centre of a crash-recovery effort.
